hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *"git commit"*) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if ! git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qx 'CLAUDE.md'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Convention checkpoint: CLAUDE.md is not staged in this commit. If this change alters a build, test, commit, or architecture convention, update CLAUDE.md in THIS commit so the rules stay in sync. If nothing convention-level changed, proceed."}}'; fi ;; esac; exit 0
